declarations.rationale: The mixed be-in/win/play-in dictionary uses sports-event targets for its largest coherent family; those contexts identify actual sporting participation. Political White House control and physical geography remain outside scope. Parent reviewed the mixed-family choice before grades.

Son/brother-of paths dominate but every target is Manhattan. These are obituary geographic attachments to named relatives, not kinship with Manhattan. Select residence with the prior obituary attachment A boundary; parent adjudicated before grading.
Tell8/speak-with2/appear-before2 and directed communication edges form the leading addressed meaning; say-of and mention are about-person rather than to-person and remain competing meanings.
Member-of/nn and membership-in dominate P0–P6; admission/accession and serving-on identify organizational membership, distinct from political control.

Literal direction is team to named coach. Coach possessive/appositive P4 and repeated coach/reporting constructions dominate coherent team-person identity; generic say and unrelated dateline/reporting pairs are not generalized into association.
Director-at P0 plus co-director and departmental director paths form the largest specific office family; spokesperson and specialist/head alone are competing predicates.
Explicit director-of/nn/possessive dominates26/41 before further director-tenure paths; head and location remain distinct.
Neighborhood/area/section/district paths dominate in place-to-containing-place direction; branch, school and project attachments require local adjudication.
Wife-appositive and accompanied/flanked-by-wife paths dominate; literal roles are named man to named wife. Daughter and ordinary interaction edges remain separate.

Send-to/iobj35/41 is the dominant dictionary pattern with political addressees; select addressed communication but preserve the legacy missing-object A boundary. No transfer/association catchall is added.
Leader appositions under body possessive/of/in/nn dominate inverse legislature/body-to-person direction. Generic says and procedural verbs do not establish the leader role alone.
Live/living16 plus explicit residence/settle/life-in dominate coherent meaning; citizenship, work, travel and geographic abstract attachments are distinct.

The dictionary genuinely mixes chief7/director6 plus further director/head-role constructions. Select existing broad formal-office family; aide/adviser/counselor/spokesman do not qualify merely by proximity.
Meet-with7/meet5/meeting-with5 plus meeting constructions dominate; send/urge/letters are communication without guaranteed encounter.
Manager possessive/of12 plus further manager-title constructions dominate; run may denote management but without an explicit manager office remains insufficient under this specific title scope.
Live/living10 and expatriate/exile/life-in form the leading residence family; diplomatic office/stationing, hospitalization and temporary location are distinct.
Section/area/neighborhood-of/in dominate P0–P4 (18 rows) with additional geographic-area paths. Travel, school and incidental location do not automatically establish containment.
Explicit editor-of/at/possessive and edit paths dominate; publisher/writer/colleague alone are excluded by this title-specific definition.
Known-as overwhelmingly dominates; correct direction is entity to alternative designation, not ownership/affiliation.

All nine literal targets are cities, and lawyer-nn/in dominates; this is professional location rather than client representation. Accountant/chair/co-op context does not replace the required lawyer role.
Scorer/score-goals/points-for and play-with paths establish athlete-to-team roles for recurring lead/give constructions; chairman/executive are competing noise.
Head/leader/chief P0–P5 dominates26/36; use the established head/leader family and retain generic-director ambiguity instead of broadening to all offices.
